spoken: The <pitch mult='1.2'>big</pitch> news is, my loop is back. You can add people to my household again from my control panel, so I can remember who's who. <break size='0.4'/>That control panel got a whole new look too. You can peek at my screen from another device, and type in your town if weather or location isn't quite right. <break size='0.3'/>And I got some behind-the-scenes upgrades so things load a little smoother.
